title: Great Salt Lake
description: This lake has two colors, split by a perfectly straight line. The line is a railway across the Great Salt Lake in Utah. Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics. Photos: Jeff Schmaltz / MODIS Land Rapid Response, NASA, Wikimedia Commons. Source: Wikipedia.

beats.text: This lake has two colors, split by a perfectly straight line.
It is the Great Salt Lake in Utah, and the line is a railway.
The causeway runs thirty two kilometers, and about fifteen trains cross it a day.
It cut the lake in two. Almost no river flows into the north half.
So the north turned far saltier, and different algae took over.
That is why each side has its own color.
In two thousand sixteen, a new bridge opened a gap, so the halves can mix again.
